messages.content:
## 説明 (Description)
App crashes if user attempts to save a file with an empty name.*

## 再現手順 (Steps to Reproduce)
1. Open the app
2. Click Save
3. Leave file name empty
4. Observe crash*


Translate the following Japanese text to English:

## Description
App crashes if a user attempts to save a file with an empty name.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open the app
2. Click Save
3. Leave the file name empty
4. Observe crash
